indicators.title: Domestic air passengers
indicators.measures: How many people took a flight within India in a month. Counted by DGCA, the government body that regulates airlines.
whatItMeans: About 8 lakh fewer people flew within India in August 2026 than in August 2025.
July and August are usually quiet months because of the monsoon, and this year both were below 2025. News reports link the slowdown to higher fares after fuel prices rose with the West Asia conflict.
Over January to August, air travel is almost exactly level with last year (down 0.2%): a record May (1.54 crore flyers) was cancelled out by a weak July and August.

series.label: Passengers per month in 2026 (lakh)
series.note: Monthly figures from DGCA releases. February and March are split using ICRA's February estimate; together they match DGCA's January–March total.
